content: Welenik biyagoŋ tubutakalene Bepaŋdi yomnik tumolokutnimuŋa nibukahilelak
Nai uŋaniŋ metam nolidi Jesu indiŋ nimbihikiŋ, “Galilihidi Bepaŋdok hemundumunduŋe tulune Pailatdi widihikumuŋguk.”
Unduŋ nimbu nadiŋa yeniŋguk, “Metam widihikumuŋguk u Galilihi metam noli yalakapmeŋ tiŋa kadakaniŋ wapum tigiŋ be dediŋ?
Moŋ hinek, hanilat. Indiŋ nadineŋ, hidi kadakaniŋhik sigilulum mu tiyemneŋ adi metam u kumuŋgiŋ undugoŋ hinek hidi maaŋ kumuneeŋ.
“Kaŋ metam 18 Siloam gwaŋ kawade yot golooŋ fooŋ widihikumuŋguk u dediŋ nadiyemiiŋ? Adi kadakaniŋhik Jelusalemhi noli’walaŋ yalakapmelak be dediŋ?
Moŋ hinek. Indiŋ nadineŋ, hidi kadakaniŋhik sigilulum mu tiyemneŋ adi metam u kumuŋgiŋ undugoŋ hinek hidi maaŋ kumuneeŋ.”
Bem gimiŋ mebi niŋ folooŋ mu wodiune figolokut titiŋdok
Unduŋ yoŋa yoyout mede indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Me niŋ adi wain fiyeŋiŋ gineŋ bim niŋ yetiguk. Ala wooŋ folooŋ kaliŋ diweguk iŋgoŋ nemu kaŋ
kwanai-meŋiŋ indiŋ niŋguk, ‘I kalaŋ, gulet lufomkulitniŋ wondok tuwot bem i folooŋnit mokit yatilak tiŋa kwet galiki hogok moŋgofit tilak ale figoloweŋ.’
“Unduŋ nimbune kwanai-meŋiŋ adi indiŋ niŋguk, ‘Biune gulet kubugoŋ yalune mebineŋ kwet wenekelemadiŋa kwet diniŋ galiki neeŋ kikololi timimbene
gulet niŋ gwelendok folooŋ nobu tibaak kaŋ bine yalaak eŋ moŋ adi fikapmaŋ titiŋdok.’”
Jesudi Sabat gulet foloŋ tam niŋ tubukedebaguk
Sabat niŋ foloŋ Jesu adi bopyotneŋ fooŋ Mede Momooŋ yoyo tuguk.
Kaŋ uŋoŋ tam niŋ yabap kadakaniŋdi fomimbu gulet 18 wondok tuwot sigiŋ mumuŋeneeŋ hatuluguk adi maaŋ uŋgoŋ ikuk.
Ala Jesudi kaŋ katinimbu buune niŋguk, “Tam, du yagitge agaŋ bigabulak.”
Unduŋ niŋa kohoŋ mebi foloŋ kameune nai uŋaniŋgoŋ sigiŋ didimeune Bepaŋ niŋa tiloloŋ tuguk.

Unduŋ tuguk kaŋ bop yot diniŋ talitimeŋ adi Jesu Sabat foloŋ kwanai tilak yoŋa nadikadaka tiŋa metam indiŋ yenintoguk, “Kadehati 6 hakiiŋ ala nai uŋaniŋ kedem buune hehitubu-kedebaluwaak, eŋ Sabat foloŋ adi mu baneeŋ.”
Unduŋ yobu Wapumdi niŋguk, “Yalaŋ-me hidi! Metam nolidi habunadiune utumba titiŋdok yoŋa yalaŋ yoiŋ. Hide hinek adi makauhik be doŋkihik Sabat foloŋ fiyali yanagi uune kilihikit be ime nanaŋ tiiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ kamiŋ Abalaham’walaŋ yalaki niŋ adi Sadaŋdi tehiguk u Sabat foloŋ mu fiyakulimindok naniiŋ.”
Unduŋ yobu metam adi nemek momooŋ tiŋak yoŋa nadifo tubune memikŋiye adi meka tigiŋ.
Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede adi mastat kilik dabugoŋ eŋ belet tububedidok haguwo wondok tuwolit
Unduŋ yoŋa indiŋ tomboyoula yeniŋguk, “Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli u dediniŋgoŋ? Maŋgoŋdut kamekaaŋ yobit kaŋ tuwot tibek?
Uyadi mastat
kilik undiniŋ. Ala me niŋdi tiŋa wooŋ fiyeŋiŋ gineŋ yetiguk kaŋ labuŋa looŋ bem wapum tubune bagi heki adi buŋa taŋeniŋ foloŋ uŋgoŋ deipilat tigiŋ.”
Unduŋ yoŋa kotigoŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli u dediniŋgoŋ yobit?
Uyadi indiŋ. Tam niŋdi belet tububedidok haguwo u palawa dut miŋobuŋa bikabune hali bedi tilak undiniŋ.”
Gigine tiŋa kunum gineŋ loloŋdok
Jesu Jelusalemde wene talipmeŋ yokwet indigoŋ wooŋ metam Mede Momooŋ yeniyeniŋ titauguk.
Kaŋ me niŋdi indiŋ ninadiguk, “Wapum, Bepaŋdi metam lufom-kabe binek yehitubu-lodaaŋ yanagilaak be dediŋ?” Unduŋ ninadiune Jesudibo indiŋ yeniŋguk,
“Metam feedi taliyeme gidaŋ gineŋ fone tiiŋ iŋgoŋ moŋ tiiŋ doktiŋa hidi uŋoŋ fofoŋdok mahik sikilitiŋa fafaŋe tiŋa foyaneeŋ.
Tiŋa yot wondiniŋ wapumdi talik tehewaak kaŋ hidi wooŋ dilitomnimbek yoŋa yeme ulaŋa nineeŋ, ‘Wapum, kedembe taliyeme dilitomnimbeŋ.’ Unduŋ nineeŋ kaŋ hanimbaak, ‘Nu hidi mu nadihamulat.’
Unduŋ hanimbaak kaŋ nineeŋ, ‘Du koom nanaŋe indut noŋgoŋ nagumun tiŋa du koom Mede Momooŋ indi yotnikwetnineŋ uŋgoŋ yoyauguŋ.’
Unduŋ nineeŋ iŋgoŋ hanimbaak, ‘Nu hidi mu nadihamulat ale metam kadakaniŋ titiŋ hidi tabaut!’
Hidi haniŋkulu kwet kadakaniŋ gineŋ fooŋ Abalaham, Aisak eŋ Jekop tiŋa polofet heki adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli gineŋ ilune yabuŋa welehik kadakaune kobulabulaye tiŋa masiŋkilip taneeŋ.
Kaŋ metam mele labulabuneŋkade buneeŋ, agaŋ mele fofoŋneŋkade buneeŋ be uŋandiŋ be uŋandiŋ buŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli gineŋ ilaŋa hinamuni tineeŋ.
Metam timeŋhi noli mindaŋ yapmewaak. Eŋ mindaŋhi noli timeŋ yapmewaak.”
Jelusalemhi mute mede yeniŋguk
Nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Falisi noli Jesu hakukneŋ buŋa niŋgiŋ, “Helot adi gulukumuŋ tibe yolak ale momoŋ tiŋa kwet niŋ weŋ.”
Unduŋ nimuntamuntayeune Jesudi yeniŋguk, “Kamo moiŋ u wooŋ indiŋ nineŋ. Kamiŋ dut haloŋ e metam yabap yehikelekuyemuŋa yagithinit yehitubu-kedebait, ala heleŋ agaŋ kwanai tubudapmaŋ tibaat.
Kuŋgoŋ oŋ, kamiŋ, haloŋ, be heleŋ kwanai titauŋila uŋoŋ usuwawaat. Tiyaugene polofet kwet yagadi hatilune ulukumuneeneŋ. Adi ulukumuŋdok kwet adi Jelusalem uŋoŋ yoŋit.

“Jelusalemhi kadayo! Hidi Bepaŋdi polofet fee hiditok yeniŋkukuk kaŋ widihikumuŋgiŋ. Kaŋ nu nai fee hinek pupupdi mihiniŋŋiye yehikwalanelak unduŋ kohonedi metamneye yehikwalanewe nadigut, iŋgoŋ hidi kamehep tinamagiŋ.

Unduŋ doktiŋa i kaneŋ. Bepaŋ agaŋ bihabulak. Yohikwehik u uyapupuheneune kwet hogok halaak. Biyagoŋ hinek hanilat. Hidi mu nabuŋa hatigene kougoŋ indiŋ yoŋa kotigoŋ nabuneeŋ, ‘Me i Wapum wou gineŋ bulak adi Bepaŋdi kahaŋ timimbek!’”

footnotes.text: Mastat diniŋ mebi kanadiwe nadiŋa pepa yendiniŋ dikiineŋ Diksineli gineŋ uŋoŋ kaweŋ.
